steps.title: A page by hand for every berry
steps.look: Cheri, Pecha, and Rawst each have a page like this, copied and edited. Pecha's page lost its flavor line, and nobody noticed. A fourth berry means a fifth file to edit.

steps.title: The berry as data
steps.look: The facts move into frontmatter (name, flavor, cures), and the grower's note is the Markdown below it. The preview hasn't changed, because nothing reads these files yet.

tokens.code:
name: Cheri Berry
flavor: spicy
cures: paralysis
---
Carry one through any route with Electric types. It works the moment your Pokémon is paralyzed, so you don't spend a turn in the bag.

tokens.content: Carry one through any route with Electric types. It works the moment your Pokémon is paralyzed, so you don't spend a turn in the bag.

steps.title: A collection with a schema
steps.look: glob() reads every .md in the folder. The schema says what every berry must have. Read it aloud like a checklist.

steps.title: The build refuses
steps.look: Pecha has no flavor, so the build stops: "berries → pecha data does not match collection schema. flavor: Invalid option: expected one of "spicy"|"dry"|"sweet"|"bitter"|"sour"". The hole the hand pages hid is now an error with a file name.

tokens.code:
name: Pecha Berry
cures: poison
---
The one to pack for caves full of Zubat. Poison keeps hurting after the battle ends, and this stops it before it does.

tokens.content: The one to pack for caves full of Zubat. Poison keeps hurting after the battle ends, and this stops it before it does.

steps.title: Fix the data, not a page
steps.look: One line, flavor sweet, and the build passes. Pecha's hand page still says nothing about flavor, because the pages don't read the collection yet.

tokens.code:
name: Pecha Berry
flavor: sweet
cures: poison
---
The one to pack for caves full of Zubat. Poison keeps hurting after the battle ends, and this stops it before it does.

tokens.content: The one to pack for caves full of Zubat. Poison keeps hurting after the battle ends, and this stops it before it does.

steps.title: The list from getCollection()
steps.look: Every berry in the collection, sorted by name. Which line decides the order?

steps.title: One file makes every page
steps.look: The three hand pages are gone. getStaticPaths() returns one path per berry, and render() gives the note's <Content />. Pecha's page now shows its flavor.

steps.title: A new berry is a new file
steps.look: Add aspear.md and build. Aspear is in the list, in order, with its own page, and no page file changed.

tokens.code:

cures: freeze
